div.head: II Cn 84.2
div.ab: And gesælig byð se hyrde, þe þonne ða heorde into Godes rice ⁊ to heofonlicre myrhþe bliðe mot lædan for ærran gewyrhtan.
And gesalig bið se hyrde, þe þonne þa heorde into Godes rice ⁊ to heofonolicre myrðe bliðe mot lædan for ærran gewyrhtan.
Et felix erit pastor, qui tunc gregem suum in Dei divitias et celeste gaudium letum perducere poterit ex pristinis operibus.
And geselig byð se hyrde ðe ðonne ða heorde into Godes rice ⁊ to heofenlicre myrðe bliðe mot lædan for ærran gewyrhtan.
And gesælig byð se hyrde þe þonne ða heorde into Godes rice and to heofonlicre myrhþe bliðe mot lædan for ærran gewyrhtan.
Und selig wird der Hirt sein, der dann die Herde in Gottes Reich und zur himmlischen Wonne freudig einführen darf wegen [ihrer] früheren Thaten.
And blessed will be the shepherd who may then joyfully lead the flock into God's kingdom and to heavenly bliss because of [their] earlier deeds.
And blessed is the shepherd who then may gladly lead his flock into the kingdom of God and to the joy of Heaven, because of the works which they have wrought.
And blessed is the shepherd who may then happily lead his flock into the kingdom of God and into heavenly bliss for the deeds they have done.
